question: Can auspicious and inauspicious experience ever be absent for that person?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious outcomes are to be experienced
That person is not devoid of them
This absence does not occur anywhere
inference: That person remains subject to auspicious and inauspicious experience in all circumstances
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things are to be experienced, and he is never anywhere devoid of them.
